title: Fractions, decimals and percentages
summary: Equivalent fractions, operations with fractions and decimals, recurring decimals and rounding, converting, percentage increase and decrease, profit and loss, and the unitary method.

cards.title: Equivalent fractions
cards.rule: Multiply or divide the top and bottom by the same number.

cards.title: Operations with fractions
cards.rule: Add or subtract: common denominator first. Divide: flip the second fraction and multiply.

cards.title: Negative fractions
cards.rule: The same sign rules as integers.

cards.title: Understanding decimals
cards.rule: Compare place by place, starting from the left.
lines: 0.5 is bigger than 0.45: 5 tenths beats 4 tenths

cards.title: Operations with decimals
cards.rule: Line up the decimal points to add or subtract. To multiply, count the decimal places. To divide, make the divisor whole.

cards.title: Recurring decimals and rounding
cards.rule: Divide the top by the bottom. It either stops (terminating) or repeats (recurring).

cards.title: Converting
cards.rule: Fraction to decimal: divide. Decimal to percentage: multiply by 100.

cards.title: Finding percentages
cards.rule: Percentage of an amount: multiply. Express as a percentage: divide and multiply by 100.

cards.title: Increasing and decreasing
cards.rule: Use a multiplier: 100% plus the increase, or 100% minus the decrease.

cards.title: The unitary method
cards.rule: Find what 1% is worth, then multiply to get what you need.
